in_hebrew.name: Jacobson
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jacobson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Testament name Jacob, meaning 'supplanter' or 'deceiver', Jacobson is a surname of Germanic origin. In the Bible, Jacob is a significant figure, known for his deceitful actions and his relationship with God.
